flags.why: The dialectal word for 'far' is characteristic of Central Vietnamese, so the Northern tag misidentifies its regional use ([source](https://ngonngu.net/loptu_phamvisudung/347)).
This meaning remains in everyday Central dialect speech and is not archaic.
The entry omits the common meaning of a scheduled feeding or dose, as in 'cữ bú' ([example](https://www.vinmec.com/vie/bai-viet/be-thuong-phai-bu-trong-bao-lau-vi)).
flags.fix: noun | a scheduled feeding or dose; ex: Bé bú sáu cữ mỗi ngày. = The baby has six feeds a day.

flags.why: The Catholic grouping includes Easter and Pentecost, while Assumption was added to form 'ngũ quý' ([source](https://vass.gov.vn/noidung/tintuc/Lists/DaoTaoSauDaiHoc/Attachments/617/Ton%20giao%20tin%20nguong%20o%20khu%20vuc%20tay%20nam%20bo%20hien%20nay.pdf)).
flags.fix: four major Catholic feasts: Christmas, Easter, Ascension and Pentecost
